method: On main e1be418, assets/, scripts/ and macrice/ were copied to a scratch directory without version-control metadata; each of scripts/build_{aero,chrome,ten,heritage}_assets.py and scripts/build_luna_control_icons.py was run with Pillow 13.0.0, plus build_heritage_assets.main(classic_only=True) for the Classic teal wallpaper. Every file under assets/ written by a generator was compared by sha256 with the tracked file. Files not listed here were not written by any generator run: hand-curated SVGs protected by scripts/ricebowl_artwork.py, wallpapers protected by _save() in build_heritage_assets.py, or files with no generator.
